provenance_schema_observations.DynamicToolCallParams: Required threadId, turnId, callId; a native turn ID is not an accepted-human-input generation.
provenance_schema_observations.ThreadInjectItemsParams: Required threadId and items; no expected-turn field in this generated schema.

claude.method: Version/help provenance; feature behavior from official documentation, not binary reverse engineering.

grok.method: Read-only version/help; passive-hook behavior from official documentation; no model work started.

public_source_followup.limit: Pinned public source and guide inspection; no installed-runtime feature test and no configuration edits.
public_source_followup.messaging_limit: Inspected owned-child/parent message capability and generic lifecycle primitives; does not establish arbitrary independent-session messaging or installed runtime behavior.

hook_provenance_observations.HookEventEnvelope: Optional prompt_id is serialized only when present; make_hook_envelope copies the supplied value without resolving a current prompt.
hook_provenance_observations.PreToolUse: make_pre_tool_use_envelope passes None for prompt_id and preserves the model call ID as tool_use_id.
hook_provenance_observations.PostToolUse: The inspected dispatch_post_tool_use_hook path passes None for prompt_id and preserves prepared.call_id as tool_use_id.
hook_provenance_observations.UserPromptSubmit: The handle_prompt path supplies Some(prompt_id) to its gate; a gate event alone is not proof of accepted human input or later tool provenance.
hook_provenance_observations.PreparedToolCall: The inspected struct holds model/ACP call IDs and an invocation ID but no prompt_id field. Other provider routes or correlations were not ruled out.
hook_provenance_observations.design_consequence: Do not fill an absent task identity from mutable current session state. Verify immutable tool-to-input correlation or a task-bound capability delivery path.
hook_provenance_observations.limit: Pinned source inspection only. Different installed build; no native hook or model session started.

mcp_provenance_observations.erased_tool: McpErasedTool.run ignores ToolCallContext. try_call_tool creates CallToolRequestParams from tool name and raw arguments without attaching that context.
mcp_provenance_observations.workspace_bridge: The common bridge ignores ToolCallContext and forwards tool name/arguments. The workspace transport builds the outgoing request from those fields.
mcp_provenance_observations.http_wrapper: post_message delegates the supplied message and headers without adding an input/task identity.
mcp_provenance_observations.session_headers: expand_session_id_headers substitutes the session ID; this is not an accepted-input generation.
mcp_provenance_observations.internal_origin: ToolCallOrigin records internal invocation/session/turn attribution; forwarding it as task authority was not established on these inspected MCP paths.
mcp_provenance_observations.design_consequence: MCP transport alone does not close S4. Verify per-call capability provenance or a supported native/managed integration; never stamp delayed calls with a latest-task header.
mcp_provenance_observations.limit: Pinned source inspection only; installed build differs. Other extension paths are not ruled out, and no MCP server, native session, or model call was started.

persisted_update_provenance_observations.pending_call: prepare_tool_call enqueues the initial ToolCall event before its pre-tool gate; send_update stamps current_prompt_id into outer promptId metadata.
persisted_update_provenance_observations.persistence: emit_notification_direct preserves notification metadata while sending it to persistence. Enqueue order alone does not prove a persisted line is available during the hook.
persisted_update_provenance_observations.normalization: Current GrokNormalizer parses outer metadata but does not propagate promptId into normalized tool_start events.
persisted_update_provenance_observations.mid_turn_steering: drain_pending_interjections submits conversation items and persists interjection-marked user chunks without replacing the outer current_prompt_id; an outer prompt ID alone does not distinguish accepted steering inputs.
persisted_update_provenance_observations.chat_history: The inspected chat-state push methods persist items through the actor; they do not independently add an immutable originating human-input identity to each model output.
persisted_update_provenance_observations.design_consequence: Candidate for call-to-native-prompt correlation, subject to accepted-input/steering boundaries, persistence ordering, replay and session-generation conformance. Never map all calls from one native prompt ID to its latest steering input.
persisted_update_provenance_observations.limit: Pinned public source and checked-in fixture only. Installed build differs; no installed session, native hook, provider call, or steering experiment was run. No raw native IDs or conversation bodies exported.

grok.usage_help_checked: grok usage <SESSION_ID> [TURN] advertises persisted session/turn usage; no session usage command was run.

claude_documentation.observation: UserPromptSubmit can block processing; observing a hook is not a post-gate acceptance receipt.

codex_documentation.observation: UserPromptSubmit supports a blocking decision; context delivery and acceptance provenance need separate verification.

grok_pinned_source.observation: dispatch_prompt_submit_hook runs before the gate verdict is enforced and before the unblocked branch advances prompt state.

prompt_acceptance_followup.integration_observation: hookServer.ts calls onPromptSubmitted for UserPromptSubmit; cli.ts immediately calls SwarmPromptScopes.started. No post-gate receipt is established by those calls alone.
prompt_acceptance_followup.limit: Official documentation and source inspection only. No installed native prompt was submitted or rejected; no configuration changes or model calls.

current_command.observation: Internal status/inbox polling is process/network work, not a model call. Returning on timeout may lead a native caller to reissue waits; no extra model-turn count or cost is established from code alone.

grok_pinned_source.tool_timeout: Configurable per-tool timeout. load_timeouts uses DEFAULT_TOOL_TIMEOUT_SECS (6000) absent overrides, consistent with the pinned guide; a nearby API comment says 60, so no installed default is inferred.
grok_pinned_source.cancellation: call_tool_cancel_aware uses a cancellable request and CancelOnDrop notifies the server when a pending future is abandoned. Server-side cancellation behavior still depends on its implementation.
grok_pinned_source.recovery: Selected transport/service failures enter recover_and_retry with the same CallToolRequestParams. The timeout branch returns a timeout and does not replay that slow operation.
grok_pinned_source.invocation_authority: These transport features do not fix the separately recorded absence of input authority in inspected outgoing MCP call context.

wait_transport_followup.design_consequence: Test an attached event-wait route separately from native yield/resume. Keep stable service IDs across transparent retries; a canceled/lost tool response channel does not automatically become an idle-turn grant.
wait_transport_followup.limit: Source and existing guide only. No native tool wait, interruption, goal-mode test, MCP server, configuration change, or paid provider call was run.
